notes: Only stages whose name contains '-v7-' are counted. attn-small v7 stages are continuations of v4/v6 trajectories; their earlier author time is reported as prior_protocol_author_wall_s and excluded from sums.

Author sessions ran as Codex `exec --ephemeral`; stdout has no per-event timestamps, so time inside a session cannot be split into reading, writing and debugging. Command counts and bytes are action composition, not time.

unaccounted_wait_s = trajectory_end_to_end_wall_s (export results.json) minus author, solve-stage and GPU walls: controller queueing for author slots (six concurrent authors) and the GPU lock. Only defined for fresh medium/long.
gpu_transport_residual_s = GPU wall including queue minus worker process active time: transfer, remote start-up and GPU-lock queueing.
